title: Panel Event Record
description: Schema for a single line in <output_dir>/events.jsonl. Each panel-run stage emits stage_started immediately after the output directory is created, and exactly one of stage_completed or stage_failed before exiting.

task_prompt_hash.description: sha256 of the task prompt; lets a resumer verify the prompt hasn't drifted

artifact_path.description: Present on stage_completed: path to the validated JSON artifact

error_reason.description: Present on stage_failed: short categorical reason token (e.g., claude_code_error)
